1. (Currently Amended) A cell comprising: a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, __wherein the non-native compartment is engineered to contain a heterologous enzyme not naturally present in the same cellular compartment as the BMC polypeptide in nature__.

2. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment is self-assembled in vivo __and the heterologous enzyme is functionally localized within the proteinaceous shell__.

3. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the non-native compartment further comprises at least one targeted enzyme __that is heterologous to the BMC polypeptide source organism__.

4. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the non-native compartment comprises a plurality of different targeted enzymes __selected from different enzymatic pathways not naturally co-localized in a single bacterial microcompartment__.

5. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 3 wherein the at least one targeted enzyme comprises a compartment-specific targeting signal sequence __that directs the enzyme to the interior of the proteinaceous shell__.

6. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the BMC polypeptide comprises a Eut polypeptide __and the non-native compartment further comprises at least one enzyme not naturally associated with ethanolamine utilization__.

7. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 6 wherein the Eut polypeptide comprises a EutS polypeptide __and the non-native compartment is engineered to encapsulate a non-native enzymatic function__.

8. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein the proteinaceous shell comprises a plurality of different BMC polypeptides __derived from different bacterial microcompartment operons or species and engineered to co-assemble with at least one heterologous enzyme__.

9. (Original) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different bacterial species.

10. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 8 wherein the plurality of different BMC polypeptides comprises BMC polypeptides from different BMC operons __and the non-native compartment encapsulates an enzyme not naturally present in any of those operons__.

11. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 wherein at least one BMC polypeptide comprises an affinity tag __and the non-native compartment further comprises at least one heterologous enzyme__.

12. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: introducing into a host cell a polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and at least one heterologous enzyme not naturally co-localized with the BMC polypeptide, thereby producing a transformed cell; and growing the transformed cell under conditions effective for the transformed cell to express the polynucleotide that encodes at least one BMC polypeptide and the at least one heterologous enzyme, and produce a non-native compartment comprising a proteinaceous shell comprising the at least one BMC polypeptide and encapsulating the at least one heterologous enzyme __for catalyzing a metabolic conversion__.

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a bacterium __and the heterologous enzyme is from a different bacterial species than the BMC polypeptide source__.

14. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Enterobacteriaceae __and the BMC polypeptide is from a non-Enterobacteriaceae source__.

15. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 14 wherein the member of the family Enterobacteriaceae comprises E. coli __and the heterologous enzyme catalyzes a metabolic function not naturally associated with the BMC polypeptide in its source organism__.

16. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 wherein the bacterium comprises a member of the family Shewanellaceae __and the non-native compartment encapsulates an enzyme heterologous to Shewanellaceae__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises a yeast __and the BMC polypeptide is from a bacterial source__.

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 wherein the yeast comprises a member of the family Saccharomycetaceae __and the heterologous enzyme is not naturally present in yeast__.

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein the member of the family Saccharomycetaceae comprises Saccharomyces cerevisiae __and the non-native compartment encapsulates a bacterial enzyme__.

20. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 12 wherein the host cell comprises an alga __and the BMC polypeptide and heterologous enzyme are from bacterial sources__.

21. (Currently Amended) A method comprising: providing a cell comprising a non-native compartment comprising: a proteinaceous shell comprising at least one bacterial microcompartment (BMC) polypeptide, and at least one enzyme that catalyzes conversion of a substrate to a product __wherein the enzyme is heterologous to the BMC polypeptide source organism__; and growing the cell under conditions effective for the at least one enzyme to catalyze conversion of the substrate to a product __for producing a desired metabolite__.

22. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a bioactive product __not naturally produced by the BMC polypeptide source organism__.

23. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a drug or a drug precursor __synthesized by the heterologous enzyme within the non-native compartment__.

24. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the product comprises a biofuel or a precursor of biofuel production __generated by enzymatic conversion not naturally occurring in the BMC polypeptide source organism__.

25. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 wherein the at least one enzyme catalyzes a step in degrading or detoxifying a toxic substrate __and the non-native compartment sequesters a toxic intermediate__.

26. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 21 further comprising isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments __that contain the heterologous enzyme__.

27. (Original) The method of claim 26 wherein at least a portion of the non-native compartment comprise an affinity tag and isolating at least a portion of the non-native compartments comprises contacting a sample comprising the non-native compartments with an affinity substrate having selective affinity for the affinity tag.

28. (Currently Amended) The cell of claim 1 comprising a plurality of compartments __each comprising at least one heterologous enzyme__.
